00.name: Sour
00.text: You always pick Sweatys side and never mine.

sour_choices_0.name: Sour
sour_choices_0.text: You pick Sweaty all the time even when they makes you drop your axe and endanger your life.

sour_choices_1.name: Sour
sour_choices_1.text: You pick Sweaty all the time even when they makes you drop your axe.

sour_choices_2.name: Sour
sour_choices_2.text: You pick Sweaty all the time even when they endanger your life.

sour_choices_3.name: Sour
sour_choices_3.text: You pick Sweaty all the time even when they makes you drop your axe and endanger your life by channeling magic into your body.

sour_choices_4.name: Sour
sour_choices_4.text: That's fine let's just follow Sweaty again even if they made you exert yourself and didn't give you a break.

sour_choices_5.name: Sour
sour_choices_5.text: That's fine let's just follow Sweaty even if they made you drop your axe.

sour_choices_6.name: Sour
sour_choices_6.text: That's fine let's just follow Sweaty again even if they almost killed you channeling magic into your body.

sour_choices_7.name: Sour
sour_choices_7.text: That's fine let's just follow Sweaty even if they let one of lord Pasta's greatest enemies walk away.

sour_choices_8.name: Sour
sour_choices_8.text: Fine I guess we can follow Sweaty this one time.

sweat_reply_0.name: Sweat
sweat_reply_0.text: I knew you were smart the moment I layed my eyes on you mortal. Sticking with me this whole time has made this adventure a breeze.

sweat_reply_1.name: Sweat
sweat_reply_1.text: Your trust in me won't be going to waste mortal. You've proved your worth multiple times this adventure and we're almost at our goal.

sweat_reply_2.name: Sweat
sweat_reply_2.text: Your trust in me won't be going to waste mortal. You've always put the quest first even at the expense of your axe, lord Pasta won't forget that.

sweat_reply_3.name: Sweat
sweat_reply_3.text: You made the correct choice picking me mortal.

02.name: Narrator
02.text: As your group continues along the trail you come across a large tree that has fallen over and is now blocking the road.

tree_before_0.name: Sweat
tree_before_0.text: Are you kidding me! Another tree!

tree_before_1.name: Sour
tree_before_1.text: Ha ha. Two fallen tree's and a broken bridge. I think you might have broken a mirror at some point Sweaty.

tree_before_2.name: Sour
tree_before_2.text: Ha ha. Two fallen tree's. That's some bad luck.

tree_before_3.name: Sweat
tree_before_3.text: This is fine. This is fine. Mortal get up here and start swinging that axe...

tree_before_4.name: Sweat
tree_before_4.text: This is fine. This is fine. Mortal get up here and start swinging that axe of yours again.

finished_0.name: Lumberjack
finished_0.text: As long as I get a rest after.

finished_1.name: Sweat
finished_1.text: Sure, sure, whatever just get it done.

tree_before_5.name: Sour
tree_before_5.text: HA HA HA HA. What axe? The one you made him give up.

tree_before_7.name: Sour
tree_before_7.text: Go ahead lumberer swing your imaginary axe.

tree_before_8.name: Sweat
tree_before_8.text: Enough. Sour we're going to channel our magic through the mortal again so they can move the tree.

no_magic_0.name: Sweat
no_magic_0.text: Enough. I've got an idea. Sour, me and you are going to channel our magic through the mortal so they can move the tree off the trail.

no_magic_1.name: Sour
no_magic_1.text: What! That's crazy. It could kill the lumberer.

no_magic_2.name: Lumberjack
no_magic_2.text: Wait I don't want to do anything that will kill me. Why can't you two use your own magic to move it.

no_magic_3.name: Sour
no_magic_3.text: It's a long story but we had our magical licences removed after we cheated at musical chairs.

no_magic_5.name: Sweat
no_magic_5.text: Look we've got no time we're almost there. We're doing this.

no_magic_6.name: Lumberjack
no_magic_6.text: Don't I get a say in this.

no_magic_8.name: Narrator
no_magic_8.text: Use the 'wasd' or arrow keys in time with the beat to channel the magic.

tree_before_9.name: Lumberjack
tree_before_9.text: What. Not again. My body still aches from the last time we did it.

tree_before_10.name: Sweat
tree_before_10.text: That's just the magic pulling your body apart. But don't worry it worked once so it will work again, probably.

03.name: Sweat
03.text: A tree. Great. Just what we need.

04.name: Sour
04.text: All I'm saying is that we wouldn't have gotten blocked by a tree if we went my way.

06.name: Sweat
06.text: No other way than to go through it. Mortal get to chopping.

no_axe_2.name: Sour
no_axe_2.text: Ha ha ha. Guess who forgot they made the lumberer drop their axe. Ha ha ha.

no_axe_3.name: Sweat
no_axe_3.text: Grrr. We'll just halve to channel our magic through the lumberer again so they can move the tree.
